name: Wolford
band_note: mean of blouse and sweater entry $275 (women's price pass, 2026-10-13); hand-band (legwear/bodywear brand; rule reads Accessible)
why: Women's tights, bodysuits, lingerie and knit ready-to-wear, tights from about $55 and bodies around $300–400, sold through its own boutiques, site and department stores.

quote.q: From the very beginning, the brand has been guided by the belief that what touches the skin has the power to shape women

opview: “From the very beginning, the brand has been guided by the belief that what touches the skin has the power to shape women” — Wolford (house), About Us, wolford.com

facts_read.source: brand site (About Us, Our History); lanvin-group.com; Modaes 2026-03-17; nordstrom.com; Vinted brand page; TRR designer directory; B Lab directory (incl. parent Lanvin); GOTS database

price_read.sublines: Wolford women's ready-to-wear clothing (tops, knit, trousers, dresses, jackets); EXCLUDED: tights/hosiery, bodysuits, lingerie, leggings/shorts, men's (Men's Pure T-Shirt)

doors.note: site wolford.com (wolfordshop.com/stores redirects to the home page; the store locator is us.wolford.com/en-us/stores/); 13 US rows: 11 Wolford Boutiques, 1 Outlet (Sawgrass Mills), and 997 Madison Avenue, which has no category on the locator and is counted as an own door from its boutique-series store ID (flagged); Wynn Plaza Las Vegas is categorised as a boutique but carries the outlet-series ID suffix FO (flagged); no US shop-in-shops or partner stores listed (all 30 shop-in-shops returned by the wide search are in Europe); the locator's city field mixes city and state; store name used as given (the locator's names are mostly addresses); ruled 10 Oct: Wynn Plaza is an outlet on its store ID
